_comment: EventBridge Scheduler rule — triggers the ClimateInsights Phase 2 Step Functions pipeline on the 2nd of each month at 06:00 UTC. The 2nd is chosen to give NOAA time to finish publishing the previous month's data.

SchedulerRule.Name: climateinsights-monthly-pipeline-trigger
SchedulerRule.Description: Triggers ClimateInsights Phase 2 monthly analytics pipeline on 2nd of each month

Input._comment: year/month injected at runtime via the transformer below

InputTransformer._comment: EventBridge passes the scheduled time as $.time (ISO-8601). The transformer extracts year and month so the state machine always knows which period to process.

_usage_notes.deployment: Use the CloudFormation template (infra/cloudformation.yaml) to deploy this rule. Or run: aws scheduler create-schedule --cli-input-json file://infra/eventbridge_scheduler.json
_usage_notes.cron_explanation: cron(0 6 2 * ? *) = 06:00 UTC on the 2nd of every month
_usage_notes.year_month_injection: EventBridge Scheduler passes its scheduled fire time. The InputTransformer extracts year/month so no Lambda is needed just to compute the current period.
_usage_notes.dlq: Failed invocations (Step Functions start failures) land in the DLQ for investigation
_usage_notes.manual_trigger: To backfill a month manually: aws stepfunctions start-execution --state-machine-arn ARN --input '{"bucket":"YOUR_BUCKET","snsTopic":"SNS_ARN","year":2020,"month":3}'
